Let <MATH_0001> be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces
which is smooth local on the source-and-target.
We say a morphism <MATH_0002> of algebraic stacks
<TEXTITOPEN_0001>has property <MATH_0003><TEXTITCLOSE_0001> if the equivalent conditions of
Lemma <REF_0001>
hold.

Let <MATH_0001> be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces
which is smooth local on the source-and-target and stable under composition.
Then the property of morphisms of algebraic stacks defined in
Definition <REF_0001>
is stable under composition. Namely, let <MATH_0002>
and <MATH_0003> be morphisms of algebraic stacks
having property <MATH_0004>. Choose an algebraic space <MATH_0005> and a
surjective smooth morphism <MATH_0006>. Choose an algebraic space
<MATH_0007> and a surjective smooth morphism <MATH_0008>.
Finally, choose an algebraic space <MATH_0009> and a surjective and smooth morphism
<MATH_0010>. Then the morphisms
<MATH_0011> and <MATH_0012> have property <MATH_0013> by definition.
Whence <MATH_0014> has property <MATH_0015> as we assumed that
<MATH_0016> is stable under composition. Thus, by definition again,
we see that <MATH_0017> has
property <MATH_0018>.

Let <MATH_0001> be a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces
which is smooth local on the source-and-target and stable under base change.
Then the property of morphisms of algebraic stacks defined in
Definition <REF_0001>
is stable under base change. Namely, let <MATH_0002>
and <MATH_0003> be morphisms of algebraic stacks
and assume <MATH_0004> has property <MATH_0005>. Choose an algebraic space <MATH_0006>
and a surjective smooth morphism <MATH_0007>. Choose an algebraic
space <MATH_0008> and a surjective smooth morphism
<MATH_0009>. Finally, choose an algebraic space
<MATH_0010> and a surjective and smooth morphism
<MATH_0011>. Then the morphism
<MATH_0012> has property <MATH_0013> by definition.
Whence <MATH_0014> has property <MATH_0015> as we assumed that
<MATH_0016> is stable under base change. Considering the diagram
<MATH_0017>
we see that the left top horizontal arrow is smooth and surjective,
whence by definition we see that the projection
<MATH_0018> has
property <MATH_0019>.
